title: Memory-allocation profiler reference solution notes
manual_validation_checklist: Compile locally with C++20 and -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic (add the external library named in the solution when applicable).
Test normal inputs and at least one boundary/failure case named in the exercise prompt.
Check integer range, object lifetime, resource cleanup and error handling where relevant.
A counting memory_resource records allocation sizes but not peak live bytes or allocation count. The figure depends on implementation choices and must not be treated as portable.
Keep this solution in repository-only protected content; do not include it in learner API responses.
status_note: Repository-only reference notes; replace with a reviewed implementation and test suite before publishing the exercise.
